subject: Handoff: HighBar Analytics deployment scope, SOW items, and CS owner
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@highbaranalytics.com>, Samir Rao <samir@highbaranalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal and draft SOW attached — Redwood + HighBar

Aisha & Samir,

Thanks again for the time last week — excited to get HighBar on Redwood. Attached is the latest SOW (HighBar_SOW_v1.2.pdf) and a short deployment_matrix.xlsx that maps responsibilities. High-level summary:

- Target go-live: 2027-01-18 (soft) / 2027-02-01 (full traffic).
- Initial scope: embeddings + chat API for internal analytics platform; single-region (us-west) deployment; 30k monthly active users projected first quarter.
- Performance SLOs: 95th p50 token latency < 320ms for standard prompt patterns; dedicated pool provisioned during business hours.
- Success criteria: integration test suite pass, one-week stability window at 80% expected load, accepted runbook.

Action items for Redwood CS: review SOW sections 3–5 (deploy schedule, rollout plan, observability hooks), confirm runbook owner, and propose a kickoff date the week of Nov 15.

Attachments: [Attachment: HighBar_SOW_v1.2.pdf (PDF), deployment_matrix.xlsx (XLSX)]

I’m cc’ing Marissa and Karthik to loop in CS and solutions. Marissa — can you pick an owner for the engagement and flag anything in the SOW that needs edits before legal signs?

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Patel <aisha@highbaranalytics.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@highbaranalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal and draft SOW attached — Redwood + HighBar

Diego,

Thanks for the SOW and matrix — this looks like it maps well to our needs. Couple of questions before we lock dates:

1) Data residency — we need to confirm logs and embeddings metadata storage will remain in US only (contract language). Is that reflected in section 6.2?
2) Maintenance windows — we need a guaranteed weekly maintenance window that doesn’t overlap our Monday morning processing (UTC). Can CS propose times?
3) Ramp capacity — the projections look conservative but we need the burst model for end-of-month runs. Is the dedicated pool configured to support short bursts without manual intervention?

Also: could you confirm what the integration test expectations are for our engineering team? We prefer a lightweight smoke test harness rather than a long QA pass.

Samir and I are available for a short call on Nov 10 or Nov 12.

Best,
Aisha Patel
VP of Product | HighBar Analytics
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@highbaranalytics.com>, Samir Rao <samir@highbaranalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal and draft SOW attached — Redwood + HighBar

Aisha — thanks, quick answers inline and forwarding to CS for ops-level confirmation:

1) Data residency: yes — section 6.2 includes US-only storage for embeddings and logs. Legal will add a short addendum in the final SOW; I flagged that with contracts.
2) Maintenance windows: Marissa, can you propose 2 standard maintenance windows that avoid Mon 08:00–11:00 UTC? HighBar prefers non-overlap with their processing window.
3) Burst capacity: the dedicated pool can burst within agreed limits; we recommend the short-burst policy in the deployment matrix. Naomi (cc) will confirm exact auto-burst behavior and limits.

Integration tests: we recommended a smoke harness (3–5 endpoints) that validates tokenization, response shape, and KV cache persistence. I’ve attached the deployment matrix with the test expectations called out.

Proposed call: Nov 12 at 10:00 AM PT — does that work?

Diego

--
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: HighBar handoff — owner nomination and pre-kickoff checklist

Team,

I reviewed the SOW and deployment matrix. I'll take primary CS ownership for this engagement (Marissa Cole — Customer Success). Naomi will be ops/infra lead for the dedicated pool and burst config. Vivek — can you own the onboarding evaluation prompts and monitoring thresholds?

Pre-kickoff checklist (I'll own completion status):
- Confirm data residency clause (contracts) — Diego to confirm legal addendum is in flight.
- Finalize maintenance window options (2) and share with HighBar.
- Confirm burst thresholds and document auto-scaling behavior (Naomi).
- Prepare smoke test harness template and share integration checklist (Vivek).
- Schedule kickoff (proposed Nov 12).

Marissa
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
